description: Make pasta from scratch, cut it into several different shapes, then cook them all and settle which shape actually holds sauce best.

title: One Color Breakfast Dinner
description: Cook breakfast for dinner using only ingredients of a single color. Yellow is easy, green is hard, and purple is a genuine problem.

title: Donuts, Decorated Badly
description: Fry a batch of homemade donuts, then decorate them as creatively or as terribly as you can manage before eating all the evidence.

title: Gas Station Gourmet
description: Shop for the entire meal at a convenience store, then head home and cook something genuinely edible out of whatever you found there.

title: Mystery Box Cook-Off
description: Each of you fills a bag with random ingredients for the other, then you both have to cook a real meal out of whatever you've been handed.

title: Roll Your Own Sushi
description: Set out rice, nori, and fillings, roll your own sushi, then rate each other's work on both appearance and structural integrity.

title: Grilled Cheese, Gourmet Rules
description: Buy fancy cheeses and good bread, then each build the best grilled cheese you can. Judging happens in bites and honesty is required.

title: Crepes With Odd Fillings
description: Make a stack of crepes, then fill them with combinations you're not sure about. Half will be great and the other half will be memorable.

title: Blind Cook, Loud Narrator
description: One of you reads a recipe out loud while the other cooks it with their eyes closed. Precision suffers, and the comedy improves considerably.

title: Waffle Topping Championship
description: Make waffles and compete on toppings and fillings, with every round judged on whether the waffle survives being picked up.

title: Granola Made at Home
description: Make your own energy bars or granola from scratch, tweak the ratio of nuts to honey, then bag it up for your next hike together.

title: Dumpling Folding Night
description: Make dumplings in several styles with different fillings, and watch your folding slowly improve over the course of the evening.

title: One Hand Each, Three Courses
description: Cook a full three-course meal with each of you allowed only one hand. Anything needing two hands forces you to actually work together.

title: Marshmallows From Scratch
description: Make marshmallows from scratch, let them set properly, then take them straight outside and roast them over a fire the same night.

title: Chop Shop Speed Round
description: Race each other to prep the same pile of ingredients. Fastest knife wins, as long as everything still comes out roughly the right size.

title: Weird Trail Mix Lab
description: Build your own trail mix with sweet, spicy, and genuinely strange additions, then test it on each other before committing to a full batch.

title: Dinner From Another Decade
description: Pick a decade, find its recipes, and cook the whole meal exactly as written. The 1970s in particular will test your commitment.

title: Local Hot Sauce Gauntlet
description: Buy hot sauces from local makers and taste your way up the heat scale, rating each one honestly before either of you gives in.

title: Sauce From Real Tomatoes
description: Simmer fresh tomatoes and herbs down into a real pasta sauce, then taste it every ten minutes until you both agree that it's finished.

title: Smoothie Bowl Scoring
description: Build smoothie bowls against each other, then award points for looks, flavor, and how long the toppings stay where you put them.

title: Blindfolded in the Kitchen
description: One of you cooks blindfolded while the other narrates every step. Swap halfway through and see which round produced the better dinner.

title: Churros and Four Sauces
description: Fry churros at home, then make several dipping sauces and work out together which combination is actually worth repeating.

title: Weird Combination Night
description: Try all the food combinations people swear by that sound completely wrong, and rank them honestly. A few will genuinely surprise you.

title: Dough From Scratch, Pizza Yours
description: Make pizza dough from scratch, then each build your own pizza exactly how you want it and trade slices once they come out of the oven.

title: Wrong Hand Cooking
description: Cook an entire meal using only your non-dominant hands. Chopping takes twice as long and everything ends up slightly crooked.

title: Cake Decorating Showdown
description: Buy plain store-bought cakes and frosting, then decorate them against each other. Skill is optional; commitment to your theme is not.

title: Make Your Own Nut Butter
description: Grind your own nut butters from scratch, try several varieties side by side, and decide which one earns a permanent spot in the cupboard.

title: Shop a Market You Don't Know
Pick a Country, Cook It
description: Choose a cuisine each time, cook a full meal from it, read up on the culture behind the food, and finish the night with a film to match.

title: Everything Is One Color
description: Pick a color and commit to it completely: the food, your clothes, even the tint on the TV. It gets absurd fast, and the photos are excellent.

title: Living Room Prom
description: Decorate the living room, dress like it's prom night, put on slow songs, and serve refreshments. No chaperones and no gym floor this time.

title: Pajamas and Saturday Cartoons
description: Meet up at 9am in pajamas, watch cartoons all morning, and eat your favorite cereal straight out of the box while you do it.

title: Waffle Bar for Everyone
description: One person supplies the batter and the toppings, and everybody else builds their own waffle. Cheap, easy, and almost impossible to do badly.

title: Pick a Theme, Any Theme
description: Choose a theme and bend the entire night around it: the food, the music, the clothes, the decorations. The sillier the theme, the better.

title: Karaoke, Primary Songs Included
description: Sing karaoke all evening, and at some point jazz up a Primary song into something nobody in the room is going to forget.

title: Mission Reunion Potluck
description: Invite returned missionaries to bring photos or slides, music, and a favorite dish from their mission, then let everyone tell their stories.

title: The Un-Talent Show
description: Everyone gets the floor to show off their weirdest, least marketable skill. Double joints and strange noises are strongly encouraged.

title: Talent Show on the Floor
description: Hold a talent show with everyone sitting on pillows and the floor. No stage, no running order, and absolutely no standards.

title: Pancakes at Seven PM
description: Make the whole breakfast spread, pancakes and bacon and scrambled eggs, then eat it at seven in the evening like it's completely normal.

title: Fresh Pasta, Kitchen Class
description: Run your own Italian cooking class at home and make fresh pasta from scratch, with flour on every surface by the time you're done.

title: Indoor Picnic, Fancy Plates
description: Build a blanket setup on the living room floor, bring out the good plates, and have a proper picnic dinner without leaving the house.

title: Grocery Store Sushi Night
description: Buy everything at a regular grocery store, then set out the rice and fillings and build your sushi rolls together on the counter.

title: Murder Mystery at Dinner
description: Assign everyone a character, hand out the secrets, and act out a murder mystery across the whole meal until someone finally gets accused.

title: Blindfolded Potluck
description: Everyone brings one dish to the potluck, but every component had to be cooked blindfolded. Results vary wildly, which is entirely the point.

title: Five Desserts, One Scorecard
description: Make five different desserts in a single night, rate each one on a scorecard, then argue about the final rankings until midnight.

title: Ten Tiny Dishes
description: Make ten small dishes and graze on them all night instead of sitting down to one big meal. Nobody has to commit to anything.

title: Fancy Fast Food Remake
description: Pick your favorite fast food meal and recreate it at home, but better: real bread, real cheese, and actual seasoning this time.

title: Candlelit Picnic in the Canyon
description: Drive up into a canyon with a proper tablecloth, real candles, and good food, then set the whole thing up somewhere with a view.

title: The Meal in Reverse
description: Start with dessert and work backwards through every course to the appetizers. It ruins your appetite in precisely the right order.

title: Watch It, Then Cook It
description: Watch a cooking show episode together first, then try to make the dish yourselves without pausing to rewatch a single step.

title: Nothing Is What It Looks Like
description: Set a candlelit table where every dish is secretly something else, like mashed potatoes made to look like cake. Watch each other's faces.

title: Hummus, Pita, Kebabs, Repeat
description: Build a Middle Eastern feast from scratch: hummus, warm pita, kebabs, and enough side dishes to cover the entire table.

title: Surprise Breakfast in Bed
description: Get up first, cook a full breakfast, and carry it in on a tray before they're properly awake. Coffee or cocoa is non-negotiable.

title: Fifteen Toppings, One Sundae
description: Set out fifteen different toppings and build the most ambitious sundae either of you can justify eating in a single sitting.

title: Sweet Crepes, Savory Crepes
description: Make crepes all evening, half of them sweet and half savory, and keep folding until the batter finally runs out on you.

title: DIY Taco Station
description: Set up a taco station with every filling and topping laid out, then find out who can build the best taco from what's on the counter.

title: No Meat, No Excuses
description: Challenge yourselves to cook a meal so good that neither of you notices there isn't any meat in it anywhere.

title: S'mores on the Porch
description: Set a small fire pit up on the front porch and make s'mores out there while waving at everyone who walks past.

title: Olives, Feta, and Tzatziki
description: Cook a full Greek spread together: olives, feta, tzatziki, grape leaves, and everything else that belongs on that table.
Cook things in the waffle iron that were never meant to go near one, sweet and savory both, and keep notes on which ones actually worked.

title: Fifteen Dollar Charcuterie Duel
description: Give yourselves $15 each and build the fanciest charcuterie board you can manage, then judge each other on looks and value for money.

title: Fold a Hundred Dumplings
description: Spend an evening folding dozens of dumplings together, steaming them in batches and eating them faster than you can possibly make them.

title: Dip Everything in Fondue
description: Melt cheese and chocolate, then dip every remotely dippable thing in the house until one of you finally calls it a night.

title: Weird Topping Pizza Night
description: Make pizzas at home and load them with the strangest topping combinations you can both agree to, then eat the evidence regardless.

title: Backyard Brunch Buffet
description: Set up a full breakfast buffet in the backyard with mimosas, virgin or otherwise, and let brunch run as long as it wants to.

title: Decade by Decade Dinner
description: Cook a 1950s casserole, a 1970s fondue, and whatever else each decade is guilty of, then compare them all as honestly as you can.

title: Instant Ramen, Upgraded
description: Start with cheap instant ramen and build it up with real broth, eggs, and toppings until it barely resembles what came in the packet.

title: Cheese Tasting, Cider Included
description: Lay out a range of cheeses and pour wine or sparkling cider, then taste your way through and take notes neither of you will reread.

title: Thirty Minutes, Five Ingredients
description: Give yourselves the same five ingredients and thirty minutes on the clock, then cook against each other and taste the results blind.

title: Grill It at the Table
description: Set up a Korean BBQ night where you cook the meat right at the table, wrapping bites in lettuce and arguing over who overcooked what.

title: Boot Scootin' in Provo
description: Head out for country dancing in Provo on a Wednesday or Saturday night, and learn the steps from whoever on the floor is willing to teach you.

title: Thursday Nights in Salt Lake
description: Drive up for country dancing in Salt Lake City on a Thursday night, where the floor fills fast and nobody minds a couple of beginners.

title: Friday Night Swing
description: Go swing dancing in Provo on a Friday night, where the band and the crowd will carry you through even if you've never done it before.

title: Learn It, Then Test It
description: Practice a few country swing moves at home until you've got them down, then take them to a real dance floor and see if they hold up.

title: Square Dance in Full Costume
description: Find an old-fashioned square dance, dress in proper old-timey clothes, and do-si-do your way through an evening nobody will let you forget.

title: Disco Night, Full Commitment
description: Go to a dance dressed head to toe in disco gear, then refuse to break character no matter what the DJ actually ends up playing.

title: Headlights and One Radio Station
description: Drive out to an empty field, park the cars in a circle facing inward, tune every radio to the same station, and dance in the headlights.

title: Parking Lot Slow Dance
description: Put music on in an empty parking lot at night and dance right there, with nothing but streetlights and painted lines for atmosphere.

title: Improv Comedy, Competitive Edition
description: Get tickets to a comedy sports show, where two teams improvise against each other and the audience decides which side was funnier.

title: Perform It Yourselves
description: Pick a play or a movie you both know well, divide the parts between you, and act the whole thing out at home with no audience at all.

title: Make a Movie, Watch It Later
description: Shoot a short film together, then leave it alone for a few weeks. Watching it back with some distance is the entire payoff.

title: Living Room Swing Lessons
description: Pull up a swing dancing tutorial on YouTube, learn the basics off the screen, then push the furniture back and freestyle from there.

title: Skate Until They Close
description: Spend a whole night at the roller rink with snacks stashed in the car, and stay right up until they turn the overhead lights on.

title: Local Band, Small Venue
description: Catch live music at a local venue, whether that's Battle of the Bands at BYU or whoever happens to be playing that night.

title: Party Bus, Nowhere to Be
description: Split a cheap party bus rental with friends and just drive around dancing, with no destination and no real reason for any of it.

title: Mall Flash Mob
description: Recruit friends, choreograph something simple, and pull off a flash mob in the middle of the mall before anyone works out what's happening.

title: Salsa Class for Beginners
description: Take a salsa class at a community center, where everyone is equally lost for the first twenty minutes and then suddenly isn't.

title: Neon Head to Toe
description: Hit an 80s night dressed in as much neon as you can physically wear, then dance to everything that decade had to offer.

title: Learn the Dance, Film It
description: Pick a few TikTok dances, learn them badly together, and film the whole thing whether or not either of you ever posts it.

title: Ballroom, From Step One
description: Take a beginner ballroom class and learn a proper frame, a basic box step, and how to eventually stop counting out loud.

title: Improv Night, Front Row
description: Catch a live improv show or an open mic night, and sit close enough that you risk getting pulled into somebody's bit.

title: Backyard Swing, One Speaker
description: Take over someone's backyard, plug an iPod into a speaker, and swing dance on the grass until the neighbors either join in or complain.

title: Merengue, Bachata, Salsa
description: Spend a night working through merengue, bachata, and salsa, and find out which one the two of you are actually any good at.

title: Clear the Garage, Dance
description: Move everything out of the garage, invite people over, and keep the music going considerably longer than anyone had planned.

title: Hip Hop Class, No Ego
description: Take a hip hop dance class together and spend the first half of it laughing at yourselves in the studio mirror.

title: Catch a Live Musical
description: Get tickets to a musical theater production, then spend the whole drive home arguing about which number was the best of the night.

title: Get On Stage Together
description: Sign up for a community talent show or dance recital and actually perform in it together, nerves and stage lights and all.

title: Line Dancing With Strangers
description: Show up for line dancing lessons at a restaurant or bar, where everyone faces the same direction and nobody notices your mistakes.

title: Rent a Hall, Dance Alone
description: Rent the cheapest dance hall in town for an hour and have the entire floor to yourselves, with whatever music you feel like playing.

title: Bachata, Then the Club
description: Learn enough bachata to fake your way through it, then take it to a Latin club and get through your first real song together.

title: Own the Reception Dance Floor
description: Go to a wedding reception where you both know people, then be the first two onto the dance floor and the very last two off it.

title: Try a Class, Any Style
description: Sign up for a community dance class in jazz, contemporary, or whatever's running that week. No experience required from either of you.

title: Summer Concert on the Grass
description: Bring a blanket to a concert in the park on a summer evening, and stay until the band finishes and the crowd has drifted off.

title: Hire a DJ, Backyard Only
description: Hire a cheap DJ to play in a backyard, invite a handful of friends, and dance on the grass until the neighbors finally tap out.

title: A Night at the Ballet
description: Get tickets to a local ballet performance and watch people do things with their bodies that neither of you thought were possible.

title: Live Music, Open Air
description: Spend a day at an outdoor festival wandering between stages, eating festival food, and finding one band neither of you had heard of.

title: Choreograph and Perform It
description: Build a real dance routine to a song you both love, rehearse it properly, then perform it for friends who never asked for this.

title: Belly Dancing, Just Because
description: Take a belly dancing class for no reason beyond the fact that neither of you has ever tried it before.

title: Jazz in a Small Room
description: Find a live jazz night at a coffee shop or club, sit close enough to see the players' hands, and talk quietly between songs.

title: Contra Dance, Caller Included
description: Go to a contra dancing evening at a community center, where a caller walks everyone through every move before the music even starts.

title: Movie Night, Mountain Edition
description: Drive up into the mountains with a laptop or a projector, set up somewhere with a view, and watch a movie with the real sky behind it.

title: Classic Drive-In Night
description: Find a drive-in theater, back the car in, pile blankets in the trunk, and watch the whole film through the windshield together.

title: Disney, Nuggets, Playground
description: Watch a Disney or kids' movie, then go get McDonald's and hit the playground afterward like the two of you are nine years old.

title: The Worst Movie You Can Find
description: Track down the worst B-movie available and talk over the entire thing. The film is bad on purpose; your commentary doesn't have to be.

title: Marathon the Whole Series
description: Pick a series, Marvel or Harry Potter or whatever you can both commit to, and watch the films back to back until someone falls asleep.

title: Projector on the Beach
description: Set up a projector at a beach or a park after dark, hang a sheet between two poles, and run your own drive-in for whoever turns up.

title: Subtitles and Dessert
description: Watch a foreign film neither of you knows anything about, then go out for dessert and argue about what the ending actually meant.

title: Trailer for Your Love Story
description: Write and film a fake movie trailer about your relationship, complete with dramatic voiceover and one completely unnecessary slow-motion shot.

title: Does It Still Hold Up
description: Pick a movie you loved as a kid, watch the whole thing as adults, and find out how much of it was ever actually good.

title: Themed Triple Feature
description: Pick a theme, one decade or one genre or one actor, and watch a run of movies that all fit it across a single night.

title: Sheet, Projector, Backyard
description: Set up a projector in the backyard, hang a sheet on the fence, and watch a movie outside with blankets, bugs, and no ticket price.

title: Paint Along to a Movie
description: Set up canvases in front of the TV and paint your way through a movie, with neither of you allowed to look down at the canvas.

title: Rom-Coms and Real Snacks
description: Line up a stack of romantic comedies and make all the snacks yourselves instead of buying them. Popcorn from the stove absolutely counts.

title: How Many Horrors Till Morning
description: Queue up horror movies back to back and see how many you can get through before one of you turns the lights back on.

title: Pilot Tonight, Binge Later
description: Watch the first episode of a series neither of you has seen, then commit to working through the rest of it over the coming weeks.

title: Sports Doc, Big Feelings
description: Put on a sports documentary that gets you both invested in a game neither of you played, then stay up talking about it afterward.

title: Cartoons From Your Childhood
description: Pull up the cartoons you each grew up on and marathon them, then argue about whose after-school lineup was genuinely better.

title: Voice the Silent Film
description: Put on a silent film and supply all the dialogue yourselves, inventing voices and motivations for every character on screen.

title: Smuggle In the Good Snacks
description: Go to the theater with a coat full of better snacks than the concession stand sells, and see whether you can get away with it.

title: Nature Doc, Then Debate
description: Watch a nature documentary together, then spend the rest of the night talking about the one animal that genuinely shocked you both.

title: Best Picture Back to Back
description: Watch several Best Picture winners in a row and decide between yourselves which ones actually deserved to win.

title: The Ones You Rewatch
description: Skip anything new and rewatch the movies you both already love, the ones where you know every line and don't care at all.

title: Talk Over the Whole Movie
description: Pick a movie and riff on it the entire way through, MST3K style, without letting a single scene pass by in silence.

title: Predictions and Award Shows
description: Watch the Oscars or the Grammys with a ballot each, lock in your predictions before it starts, and keep score all the way through.

title: Something Weird and Beloved
description: Watch a cult classic that everyone quotes and nobody explains properly, then decide whether the two of you are now in on it.

title: Two Westerns, One Night
description: Run a double feature of old western classics, with the second one starting no matter how late the first one finishes.

title: Somebody Else's Life Story
description: Watch a biographical film about someone you admire, then look up afterward how much of it was actually true.

title: All Animation, All Night
description: Run a whole night of animated films only, from the ones made for kids to the ones that very much were not.

title: Call the Twist Early
description: Watch a thriller and race each other to guess the ending. Whoever calls the twist first gets bragging rights for a week.

title: Movies Nobody Has Heard Of
description: Each pick a film nobody talks about and make the other one watch it. You're both defending your choice when the credits roll.

title: One Director, Three Films
description: Pick a director and watch several of their films in a row, then try to name everything that turns up in all of them.

title: Original Versus Remake
description: Watch the original film and then its remake back to back, and settle between you which one actually earned the right to exist.

title: Pick a Film for Each Other
Ride the Coin-Op Animals
description: Find the little coin-operated animal rides at the mall and take turns on every one of them, dignity firmly set aside for the evening.

title: Mannequin Mode
description: Stand perfectly still among the mannequins in a clothing store and see how long it takes before a shopper visibly reacts.

title: Escalator Tag
description: Play tag through the mall using only the escalators, which is considerably harder than it sounds and much funnier to watch.

title: Two People, One Pair of Pants
description: Buy the biggest pair of pants you can find, get into them together, and hop your way around the mall as one very wide person.

title: Lawn Chairs at the Salon
description: Set up lawn chairs outside the mall hair salon and watch strangers get their haircuts like it's a live sporting event.

title: Mall Hide and Seek
description: Play hide-and-seek in the mall as couples, then meet over banana splits to compare where everyone hid and who nearly got caught.

title: Upgrade the Cheap Sunglasses
description: Buy the cheapest sunglasses you can find, then take them home and decorate, modify, or thoroughly destroy them into something better.

title: Ten Dollars of Art Supplies
description: Go to Walmart with $10 between you, buy whatever materials that covers, and make an art project using only those things.

title: Thrift Outfit, Airport Debut
description: Pick out an outfit for each other at a second-hand store, then wear it to the airport and enjoy how people react.

title: Shopping With Suitcases
description: Bring empty suitcases to the store and load them up instead of using carts. Commit to it fully and answer no questions.

title: Dig Through Somebody's Attic
description: Spend an afternoon at Somebody's Attic hunting through the racks and shelves for whatever neither of you knew you needed.

title: Antique Store Treasure Hunt
description: Wander an antique store and each pick out the one thing you'd take home if money were no object, then explain your choice.

title: Find the Comfiest Couch
description: Work your way through furniture stores testing every couch and chair, and keep ranking them until you've found the single best one.

title: Formal Wear, No Occasion
description: Walk into a nice store and try on the fanciest clothes they have, with no event to attend and no intention of buying anything.

title: Ugliest Thing Under a Dollar
description: Hit the garage sales with a dollar each and compete to bring home the ugliest, strangest object either of you can find.

title: What Will DI Have Today
description: Walk into DI with no list and no plan at all, and see what the shelves happen to be holding for the two of you that day.

title: Patch Up Thrift Store Denim
description: Buy jeans or shirts at DI, order a batch of iron-on patches, and turn cheap secondhand clothes into something you'd actually wear out.

title: Swim in Your Sunday Best
description: Buy dress clothes at DI for a couple of dollars, put them on, and jump straight into the water still wearing them.

title: Fake Labels, Real Confusion
description: Make up fake product labels at home, then stick them on random items at the store and see if anyone notices before you leave.

title: Unofficial Store Employees
description: Dress the part, walk the aisles, and help other shoppers find things you know nothing about. Keeping a straight face is the hard part.

title: Every Mirror in the Mall
description: Find every mirror in the mall and take an increasingly ridiculous photo in each one until you run out of mirrors or ideas.

title: Escalator Speed Run
description: Ride every escalator and elevator in the mall and time the whole circuit, then come back another day and try to beat it.

title: Weirdest Thing in Every Store
description: Go store to store finding the strangest item on the shelves, then text the photos to your friends with no explanation at all.

title: Stop-Motion in the Aisles
description: Use whatever's on the shelves to shoot a stop-motion video in the mall, one photo at a time, before anyone asks what you're up to.

title: The Most Outrageous Outfit
description: Go thrift shopping and build the loudest, most outrageous outfit combination the two of you can assemble from the racks.

title: Marco Polo, Quietly
description: Play a low-volume game of Marco Polo in a department store, quiet enough that nobody else has to be dragged into it.

title: Every Hat in the Store
description: Work through the entire hat section, trying on every one and photographing each, then decide which of them suits whom.

title: The Most Uncomfortable Living Room
description: Rearrange a display in a furniture store into the least functional, most deeply uncomfortable living room setup imaginable.

title: Sephora Makeover Dare
description: Dare each other into a Sephora makeover, sit through the whole thing, then walk the mall looking completely transformed.

title: Every Sample, Every Time
description: Work your way through every sample at the sample station, going back around as many times as you can reasonably get away with.

title: Commercial for Something Boring
description: Pick the dullest item in the mall and film an overdramatic commercial for it, complete with slow zooms and a very serious voiceover.

title: Do You Carry This
description: Go into a store and ask for increasingly ridiculous items with total sincerity, and see how long the staff keeps playing along.

title: Ten Dollar Costume Challenge
description: Give yourselves $10 each at a thrift store and find matching outfits, with no discussing beforehand what you're aiming for.

title: Charades With Store Products
description: Play charades in a store where every clue has to be acted out using only what's on the shelves, and nobody is allowed to speak.

title: Music Video, Home Goods Aisle
description: Pick a song and film an entire music video inside a home goods store, using the displays as your set and the aisles as your stage.

title: Wedding Dress Photo Shoot
description: Try on wedding dresses purely for the drama of it, and take the most over-the-top photos the fitting room mirror will allow.

title: Mannequin Rearrangement Project
description: Quietly restage the mannequins into poses and groupings nobody intended, then walk away and let the scene do its own work.

title: Show Us the Priciest Thing
description: Walk into an expensive store and ask, entirely straight-faced, to be shown the single most expensive item they have in stock.

title: Thirty Minute Lookbook
description: Set a thirty-minute timer at a thrift store and shoot an entire fashion lookbook together before the clock runs out on you.

title: Lost in the Department Store
description: Play a careful, respectful game of hide-and-seek in a big department store, where the racks do most of the hiding for you.

title: Model in the Shop Windows
description: Pose like you belong in the display window of every store you pass, and get the photo before anyone inside notices you.

title: Five Dollar Haul Video
description: Find the weirdest things you can for under $5 each, then film a full haul video reviewing every single one of them.

title: Matching Outfits, Fitting Room
description: Play dress-up in a costume or formal wear store, picking matching outfits for each other and modeling every last one.

title: Changing Room Photo Series
description: Take a photo of yourselves in every changing room mirror you come across, until you've built a whole series by closing time.

title: The Fashion Fails Collection
description: Hunt down the worst clothing in the mall and photograph each other wearing it, building a proper fashion fails series as you go.

title: Wear the Ugliest Thing
description: Each pick the ugliest item you can find for the other, then wear whatever you're handed for a full hour in public.

title: Find the Emoji in Aisle Five
Five Dollars at the Dollar Store
Style Me for the Red Carpet
Clues Hidden in the Mall
description: Run a scavenger hunt with clues stashed in mall stores, calling each other on your phones to trade hints as you go.

title: Record Every Sound on the List
description: Make a list of sounds to capture, head out with a recorder each, then compare what the two of you came back with.

title: Clues Under Rocks
description: Hide clues under rocks and in tree branches around the park, then send each other hunting from one to the next.

title: Draw a Map, Bury the Loot
description: Make a proper treasure map, then bury something worth finding on Sam's land or up in the canyon and mark the spot carefully.

title: Photo Clues, Surprise Dinner
description: Take photos of yourselves at local landmarks, use them as clues for another couple to follow, and have a meal waiting at the final stop.

title: Survey Strangers on Campus
description: Write a survey, funny or serious, then ask people at the mall or on campus to answer it and compare the results afterward.

title: Anonymous Mail for a Month
description: Fill out a stack of Just Because cards and mail them anonymously to the same person, one at a time, for an entire month.

title: Pass the Sign
description: Play Signs in a circle, where everyone has a gesture and you steal each other's by imitating them. It gets fast and chaotic quickly.

title: The Two Dollar Date
description: Each couple gets $2 and one hour to pull off a real date, then everyone meets back up to compare what that actually bought.

title: Fill the Cart, Swap the Cart
description: Race to fill a grocery cart with one item from every aisle, then trade carts with another couple who has to re-shelve all of it.

title: Beat the Escape Room Clock
description: Book an escape room and work the puzzles together against the timer, then argue on the drive home about who cracked the last one.

title: Recreate the Absurd Poses
description: Write a list of ridiculous poses, then go out and photograph each other recreating every single one of them in public.

title: GPS Says Treasure Here
description: Use a geocaching app to track down hidden containers around town, sign the logbooks, and leave something small behind in each.

title: Trivia Night, Terrible Team Name
description: Join a trivia night at a local restaurant or brewery, pick an unnecessarily elaborate team name, and try to actually win something.

title: Landmarks Along the Trail
description: Make a list of landmarks and natural objects to find along a hiking trail, then tick them off one by one as you climb.

title: Sixty Seconds, Silly Prizes
description: Run a set of minute-to-win-it games using household objects, with prizes ridiculous enough to make the competition genuinely fierce.

title: Defend the Fort
description: Build a fort worth defending, then invite another couple to try and take it. Agree the rules first and the terms of surrender second.

title: Paint Rocks, Hide Rocks
description: Paint a batch of rocks together, hide them around town for strangers to find, and go hunting for the ones other people left.

title: Mario Kart Grudge Match
description: Run a video game tournament at home, Mario Kart or Smash Bros or whatever you own, with a real bracket and real consequences.

title: Secret Ingredient, Ticking Clock
description: Set a time limit, reveal a secret ingredient, then cook against each other exactly like the show, dramatic commentary included.

title: Spelling Bee, High Stakes
description: Run a spelling bee using absurd words, with stakes high enough that both of you end up taking it far too seriously.

title: Three Seconds to Guess
description: Draw something, show it for exactly three seconds, then make the other guess what it was. Bad drawing is a genuine advantage here.

title: Fifty Stickers Around Town
description: Hunt down fifty unique stickers across town, on poles and windows and bumpers, photographing every single one you find.

title: One Sentence Each
description: Take turns adding a single sentence to a story until it turns completely absurd, with neither of you allowed to plan ahead.

title: Thirty Minutes of LEGO
description: Pick a theme, set a thirty-minute timer, and build against each other out of the same shared pile of LEGO.

title: Count the States
description: Spend an hour spotting license plates and counting how many different states the two of you can find between you.

title: Ten Card Games, One Night
description: Play ten different card games back to back in a single sitting, keeping a running overall score across all of them.

title: Race to Finish the Puzzle
description: Buy two identical puzzles, start at the exact same moment, and race to finish first with absolutely no helping each other.

title: Old Buildings, New Eyes
description: Walk a part of town you don't know and photograph the architecture and old buildings you've driven past for years without seeing.

title: Chalk Art Face-Off
description: Claim two squares of sidewalk at the park, set a time limit, and let whoever walks past decide which chalk drawing is better.

title: Losers Buy Dessert
description: Run a board game tournament across the evening, with the losing side buying dessert for everybody at the end of it.

title: Couples Charades Showdown
description: Face off against another couple in charades, with each pair writing the clues for the other and absolutely no mercy shown.

title: Bullseye or Nothing
description: Find a local spot with a dartboard and play all night, switching games whenever one of you starts winning a bit too often.

title: Absurd Clues for Friends
description: Write a scavenger hunt full of ridiculous clues, send your friends out on it, and follow at a distance to watch them struggle.

title: Rope, Mud, Two Teams
description: Get a group together at the park for a tug of war, then run rematches until everybody's arms have completely given out.

title: Who Hops Fastest
description: Get two sacks, mark out a start and a finish line, and race until one of you is definitively the better hopper.

title: How Well Do You Know Me
description: Write trivia questions about each other and your relationship, then quiz back and forth to see who's been paying attention.

title: Rapid Fire Word Association
description: Go back and forth on word association as fast as you can, and see where twenty seconds of pure instinct takes the two of you.

title: Who's Better at What
description: Invent a series of small skill contests, throwing and balancing and aiming, then settle once and for all who wins each one.

title: Remember What You Saw
description: Photograph things as you move around town, then test each other later on how much detail either of you actually retained.

title: Juggling, One Ball at a Time
Stilts, Step by Step
description: Get hold of a pair of stilts and teach each other to walk on them, holding onto a wall until neither of you needs it anymore.

title: Try a Class, Sweat Together
description: Sign up for a workout class together, whether that's yoga, pilates, or something that leaves you both properly sore tomorrow.

title: Learn to Drive Stick
description: Find an empty lot and a manual car, then teach each other to work the clutch without stalling more than a dozen times each.

title: Back Up the Trailer
description: Take a trailer to an empty lot and practice reversing it together until the backwards steering finally starts making sense.

title: Tractor Driving Course
description: Learn to drive a tractor, or set up your own driving course with cones and obstacles and time each other running it.

title: Beard Art, Razor Included
description: Grow a beard out properly, then hand your date the razor and let them shave whatever design they want into it. No vetoes.

title: Everything in Metric
description: Measure each other in meters and weigh in kilograms, then spend the rest of the night converting everything else you can find.

title: Half a Haircut Now
description: Let your date cut half your hair at the start of the date and the other half at the end. You are fully committing to this.

title: Read It, Then Argue
description: Pick a book neither of you has read, work through it at the same pace, and meet up to argue about it chapter by chapter.

title: Study Group, Odd Subjects
description: Start a study group where every session covers a completely different subject and everyone has to teach something they just learned.

title: Borrow an Expert
description: Find someone who's genuinely good at something and ask them to teach the two of you, whatever it is they happen to know.

title: Sushi Rolling Lesson
description: Take a lesson in rolling sushi properly, where somebody corrects your rice-to-filling ratio before it turns into a permanent habit.

title: Point the App at the Sky
description: Use a stargazing app to work out what you're actually looking at, then try naming the constellations again without it.

title: Say It With Your Hands
description: Learn basic sign language together, starting with the alphabet and the handful of phrases you'd actually use on each other.

title: Cook a Cuisine You Don't Know
description: Sign up for a cooking class in a cuisine neither of you has ever attempted, and walk in knowing absolutely nothing about it.

title: Knots Worth Knowing
description: Learn to tie a handful of knots that actually get used, then test them out on shoelaces, camping gear, and each other.

title: Composition on Foot
description: Take a walk with cameras and learn the basics of composition as you go, reshooting the same subject until it finally looks right.

title: Flour, Eggs, and Patience
description: Learn to make pasta from scratch, starting with a pile of flour and a couple of eggs and ending somewhere considerably better.

title: Makerspace Woodworking Basics
description: Take a beginner woodworking class at a makerspace, where all the tools are there and somebody stops you before you lose a finger.

title: Learn the Bird Calls
description: Join a guided nature walk and learn to identify birds by sight and by sound, starting with the ones in your own backyard.

title: Salsa, Ballroom, or Swing
description: Sign up for a dance class and pick whichever style the two of you would be most embarrassed to be bad at in public.

title: Candle Making Lesson
description: Take a candle-making class and learn how wick size, wax, and scent actually work before you start improvising at home.

title: Write Your First Code
description: Take a beginner coding class online together, work through the same lessons, and build something small that actually runs.

title: Master the Dough and Sauce
description: Learn to make pizza dough and sauce from scratch, then keep testing batches until you land on a recipe worth repeating.

title: First Climbing Lesson
description: Take a beginner class at an indoor climbing gym and learn to tie in, belay, and trust the rope with someone watching closely.

title: Watercolor for Beginners
description: Take a watercolor class and learn exactly how much water is too much water, which is basically the whole skill in one lesson.

title: Make Your Own Jerky
description: Learn to make jerky from scratch, from picking the right cut to slicing it thin to waiting a lot longer than you'd like.

title: An Origami Zoo
description: Learn to fold origami animals one at a time, and keep going until there's a small paper zoo sitting on the table.

title: Tennis, From the Grip Up
description: Take an intro tennis lesson together and learn the grip, the swing, and exactly why neither of you could serve before now.

title: Macarons, Properly Done
description: Learn to make macarons, which are far harder than they look, then decorate whichever ones come out of the oven intact.

title: Gloves On, Bag Work
description: Take a boxing or kickboxing fitness class and spend an hour hitting pads until your arms stop cooperating with you.

title: Ice Cream, Made at Home
description: Learn to make ice cream from scratch, tasting it at every stage so you know exactly where it went right or wrong.

title: Center the Clay
description: Take a wheel-throwing class, a completely different beast from hand-building, and learn to center clay without collapsing it.

title: Terrarium Building Class
description: Take a terrarium class and learn which plants actually survive in a sealed jar, then build one you have a chance of keeping alive.

title: Forage With Someone Who Knows
description: Join an expert-led foraging walk and learn which plants are genuinely worth picking and which ones you should absolutely leave alone.

title: Soap Making Class
description: Take a soap-making class and learn the chemistry behind it, then go home with bars that need a few weeks of curing before use.

title: Refinishing Workshop, Sanding Included
description: Take a furniture refinishing workshop and learn to strip, sand, and finish a piece properly instead of guessing your way through it.

title: Blend Your Own Granola
description: Learn to make granola and trail mix blends from scratch, then dial in the sweet-to-salty ratio that the two of you actually like.

title: First Chords Together
description: Take a ukulele or guitar lesson together and learn enough chords between you to butcher exactly one song by the end of the hour.

title: Make Your Own Lip Balm
description: Learn to make lip balm from wax and oil, pick your own scents, and pour a batch small enough to live in a coat pocket.

title: Swing Class at the Ballroom
description: Take a swing dancing class at a local ballroom, where the floor is proper wood and somebody will actually correct your footwork.

title: Pull a Shot, Pour a Heart

description: Take a list of random items and, as couples, shoot one photo that secretly hides every single one. Whoever's picture stumps the other couples the longest wins.

title: Walk Into a Random Building
description: Pick a building neither of you has ever been inside, walk right in, and wander around until somebody asks what you're doing there.

title: Small Fire, Big Extinguisher
description: Set a small controlled fire somewhere safe and open, then put it out with an extinguisher just to know what that feels like.

title: Glowing Rocks Across the Water
description: Crack open glow sticks, coat a few flat stones in the glow, and skip them across a dark lake to watch the light trail out.

title: DIY Paint Wars
description: Load squirt bottles with washable paint or colored water and fight it out like paintball, wearing clothes you'll never wear again.

title: Fake Hitchhikers in Logan
description: Stuff duffel bags with newspaper, stand at the roadside in Logan with your thumbs out, and see how long you can keep the bit going.

title: Payphone Prank Calls
description: Track down a working payphone, call someone at random, or ring information and ask them very seriously for Santa's mailing address.

title: Riddle Me This
description: Trade riddles back and forth until one of you finally gives up, then argue about whether that answer was ever fair to begin with.

title: Reverse Trick-or-Treating
description: Dress up in costume and go door to door handing candy out to strangers instead of asking anybody for any.

title: Painted Cans, Puzzled Drivers
description: Paint a row of garbage cans, line them up along the road, and film the reactions of everyone who drives past them.

title: Trick-or-Treat in March
description: Put on costumes and go trick-or-treating in a month nowhere near Halloween, and find out who plays along and who shuts the door.

title: Let the Coin Choose Dinner
description: Flip a coin at every intersection to decide which way to turn, then eat at the very first restaurant you end up in front of.

title: Predawn Kidnapping, Campfire Breakfast
description: With permission from their parents or roommates, grab your date before sunrise in nothing but pajamas, shoes, and a coat, and drive out to a campground for breakfast by the fire.

title: Cereal by Candlelight
description: Bring bowls, milk, and candles to an empty parking lot at night and eat cereal there like it's the most romantic thing imaginable.

title: The Junkiest Car in Town
description: Go to dinner and a movie in the oldest, most questionable vehicle you can borrow, and pull up to the curb with total confidence.

title: The Grave With Snacks Inside
description: Bury a fake coffin packed with snacks, then convince your date it's an old grave working its way back up and hand them a shovel.

title: Caroling in July
description: Go door to door singing Christmas carols in the middle of summer, and commit to it completely no matter how people react.

title: Cemetery After Dark
description: Wander a cemetery at night if your date is into that kind of atmosphere, reading headstones and inventing the stories behind them.

title: The Menu Is a Lie
description: On a double date, serve the same dish several times under different fancy names on a printed formal menu, and see who catches on first.

title: Rate the Neighborhood Yards
description: Drive through different neighborhoods scoring the best and worst landscaping, with bonus points for truly committed yard ornaments.

title: Airport People Watching
description: Head to the airport to watch planes take off, people-watch the arrivals hall, and grab food while trading travel stories.

title: Hotel Lobby Loitering
description: Wander into a hotel lobby mid-walk, settle into the good furniture, and watch the TV and the people like you belong there.

title: The Hidden Camera Guessing Game
description: Set up a dating-game-style guessing round with a camera quietly rolling, and let the reactions be the entire point of the evening.

title: Tour Houses You Can't Afford
description: Visit open houses well outside your budget and talk seriously about the kitchen, the light, and where exactly the piano would go.

title: Santa and Mrs. Claus Visit
description: Dress up as Mr. and Mrs. Claus and go visit the neighborhood kids, fully in character and with candy in hand.

title: A Day in Court
description: Go to the county courthouse and sit in on a trial in session. It's free, it's public, and it beats most television.

title: Behind the Factory Doors
description: Call ahead and book a factory tour, then spend an hour watching how something you both use every day actually gets made.

title: Swap Cars With a Stranger
description: Try to convince a total stranger to trade cars with you for the evening, and see how far that conversation gets you.

title: Park Course, Stopwatch Running
description: Build an elaborate obstacle course across a park using benches, trees, and whatever else is out there, then time each other through it.

title: Weird Food Combo Hunt
description: Race through a grocery store hunting for the strangest food combinations on the shelves, then judge each other's finds at the checkout.

title: Terrible Outfits, Nice Restaurant
description: Wear intentionally mismatched, genuinely ugly outfits to a nice restaurant and behave as though nothing at all is unusual.

title: Missing Person, Reward Offered
description: Make fake lost pet posters using each other's photos and details, then hang them around campus and wait for the texts to start.

title: Formal Wear, Water Balloons
description: Dress like you're headed somewhere important, then have a full water balloon fight in a parking lot in exactly those clothes.

title: Buy Each Other Something Awful
description: Go to a thrift store, buy the worst outfit you can find for the other, then wear whatever you're given out in public.

title: Marco Polo, Crowded Pool
description: Play Marco Polo in a busy public pool, where half the strangers around you will end up joining in entirely by accident.

title: The Fake Survey Calls
description: Call numbers at random and try, very politely, to convince whoever picks up that you're conducting an extremely strange survey.

title: Dessert, Dinner, Appetizers
description: Eat the entire meal in reverse: dessert first, then the main course, then appetizers last, and see if anyone's still hungry.

title: Trailer for a Fake Movie
description: Invent a completely ridiculous film, then write and shoot the trailer for it, dramatic voiceover and unnecessary pauses included.

title: The Fake Breakup Scene
description: Stage an extremely dramatic fake breakup in a public park and see how many passersby stop, stare, or try to intervene.

title: Order in Someone Else's Voice
description: Take turns ordering at the drive-thru doing celebrity impressions, and find out which one survives the entire interaction.

title: The Ministry of Silly Walks
description: Walk down a busy sidewalk using the most ridiculous gaits you can manage, and let the strangers decide who committed harder.

title: Boy Band Lip-Sync Battle
description: Pick 90s boy band tracks, choreograph something regrettable, and hold a full lip-sync battle with a winner declared at the end.

title: Voice the Pet Store Animals
description: Wander a pet store making up the conversations happening between the animals, and give every single one a distinct voice.

title: The Compliment Roast
description: Trade insults disguised as compliments until one of you can't keep a straight face. Nothing is allowed to be genuinely mean.

title: Teach Strangers Your Handshake
description: Invent an unnecessarily complicated secret handshake, then try to teach it to strangers until somebody actually gets it right.

title: Live Commentary, Amateur Sports
description: Go to a low-stakes amateur sporting event and provide your own whispered play-by-play as though it were the championship final.

title: Bubble Wrap Showdown
description: Get a roll of bubble wrap, split it evenly, and race to pop every last bubble in a parking lot. Stomping is entirely permitted.

title: Have You Seen My Sibling
description: Make fake lost sibling posters using each other's photos and invented details, then put them up around town and see who calls.

title: Department Store Dress-Up
description: Work your way through department stores trying on the most ridiculous outfits you can find, one fitting room at a time.

title: How Far Can You Spit
description: Line up with watermelon or sunflower seeds, mark a line on the ground, and compete on distance until someone sets a real record.

title: Take Seventeen of the Dance
description: Choreograph a short dance and film take after take until one of them is good enough to keep, or at least funny enough to.

title: House Hunting, Fully in Character
description: Walk a furniture store pretending to be a married couple furnishing your first home, and argue seriously about the couch.

description: Splurge on a farm-to-table dinner at Communal for a real occasion, and order the thing you'd normally talk yourself out of.

title: Rooftop Plates at Slate
description: Share Mediterranean small plates on the rooftop patio at Slate Restaurant, then order a second round of whichever one won.

title: Candlelight Among the Lemon Trees
description: Drive to Orem for a candlelit dinner among the lemon trees at La Jolla Groves, which looks exactly as good as it sounds.

title: Farm to Table at Block
description: Try the farm-to-table menu at Block Restaurant in Orem, and ask your server what came in fresh that week.

title: Split a Pie at Mozz
description: Split a Neapolitan-style pizza at Mozz, where the crust is the whole point and the char on it is entirely deliberate.

title: Detroit-Style at Via 313
description: Order the biggest Detroit-style pizza the two of you can realistically finish at Via 313 in Orem, then regret nothing.

title: Settle the Curry Debate
description: Order competing curries at Bombay House, the reigning king of Indian food in Utah Valley, and settle which one actually wins.

title: Buffet Day at India Palace
description: Load up on the lunch buffet at India Palace, and make a full lap of the table before either of you sits down.

title: Vindaloo and Korma at Kohinoor
description: Try the lamb vindaloo and the coconut korma at Kohinoor in Orem, then trade plates entirely halfway through.

title: Spiciest Curry at Bangkok Wasabi
description: Get Thai and Japanese fusion at Bangkok Wasabi in Orem, and find out which of you can handle the spiciest curry.

title: Build Your Order at Happy Sumo
description: Roll your own sushi order at Happy Sumo, with each of you building something the other has to try at least one piece of.

title: Dress Up for Slackwater
description: Dress up for upscale dining at Slackwater in the Riverwoods, then take the long way through the shops afterward.

title: A Slice Before the Movie
description: Grab a casual slice at Two Jacks Pizza before a movie, which is unquestionably the correct order of operations.

title: A Night at the Covey
description: Catch a play or a concert at the Covey Center for the Arts in downtown Provo, then walk somewhere for dessert after.

title: The Grand Theatre at SCERA
description: See a show in the historic 733-seat Clarke Grand Theatre at the SCERA Center for the Arts in Orem.

title: Velour Before They're Famous
description: Catch a rising local band at Velour Live Music Gallery, the venue where Imagine Dragons and Neon Trees both got their start.

title: New Release at Cinemark Provo
description: Watch a new release at Cinemark Provo 16, then go somewhere for dessert and argue about whether it was actually any good.

title: Lost at Glen Rays
description: Get lost in the corn maze at Glen Rays in Spanish Fork, then dare each other into the Field of Fright after dark.

title: Cornbelly's After Dark
description: Take on the corn maze and the nighttime challenges at Cornbelly's at Thanksgiving Point, and stay until they shut the gates.

title: Small Maze, Big Fall Energy
description: Wander the small corn maze and the fall activities at Vineyard Garden Center in Orem for an easy, low-key autumn afternoon.

title: Hayride at Hee Haw Farms
description: Pick pumpkins and take a hayride at Hee Haw Farms in Pleasant Grove, and come home with more squash than you need.

title: Pumpkins at Jaker's
description: Go pumpkin picking at Jaker's Jack-o-Lanterns in Springville, and each pick one you'll carve together that same night.

title: Saturday at the Provo Market
description: Grab local produce and breakfast burritos at the Provo Farmers Market on a Saturday morning, and eat while you walk.

title: Shop the Sunset Market
description: Browse the Orem Sunset Farmers Market, pick out ingredients together, then go home and cook dinner from exactly what you found.

title: The Pumpkin Train
description: Ride the Heber Valley Railroad Pumpkin Train together in the fall, which is every bit as charming as it sounds.

title: Christmas Around the World
description: Go see BYU's Christmas Around the World display in December, and pick which country's dancing you'd most want to learn.

title: Alpine Loop in Full Color
description: Drive the Alpine Loop Scenic Drive during peak fall foliage and stop for photos at every single overlook along the way.

title: Temple Grounds at Dusk
description: Walk the grounds and the visitor center at the Provo City Center Temple, taking your time all the way around the outside.

title: Three Museums, One Afternoon
description: Work through the BYU Museums Complex in a single afternoon: the Bean Museum, the Museum of Art, and the Museum of Paleontology.

title: Chairlift Lunch at Sundance
description: Ride the scenic chairlift at Sundance Mountain Resort and have lunch at the top with the whole canyon laid out in front of you.

title: Bikes or Ropes at Sundance
description: Book a mountain bike tour or a ropes course session at Sundance, and let the mountain handle the difficult part.

title: Boardwalk Over the Springs
description: Walk the boardwalk over the pools at Cascade Springs in Provo Canyon and watch how clear the water runs underneath.

title: Playground Built for Everyone
description: Let the kid in you loose at the All-Together Playground in Orem, and race each other across every piece of it.

title: An Hour at Get Air
description: Jump around for an hour at Get Air Hang Time trampoline park in Orem, then limp out to the car together afterward.

title: Saturday at University Place
description: Spend a Saturday at University Place in Orem shopping, eating, and cooling off at the splash pad when it gets hot.

title: Outdoor Movie at the Orchard
description: Catch an outdoor movie night at The Orchard at University Place in Orem, and bring a blanket worth sitting on.

title: Timpanogos on Your Left
description: Bike or run a stretch of the Murdock Canal Trail with Mount Timpanogos sitting there as your backdrop the entire way.

title: Musicals at the SCERA Shell
description: See a big outdoor musical or concert at the SCERA Shell Outdoor Theatre in Orem, performed under an actual sky.

title: Three Shops, One Ranking
description: Do a Provo coffee-shop crawl with one drink each at three different local shops, then rank them before you go home.

title: Three Scoops, One Night
description: Do a Provo and Orem creamery crawl with one small scoop at three different local ice cream spots in a single evening.

title: A Full Day in the Canyon
description: Plan an entire day in Provo Canyon: Bridal Veil Falls, a picnic at Vivian Park, and a stop at Cascade Springs.

title: Hike First, Black Sheep After
description: Combine a Rock Canyon hike with dinner at Black Sheep Cafe afterward, which is a fair trade for all that elevation.

title: Thrift Win, Ice Cream Reward
description: Go thrifting at DI, then get creamery ice cream to celebrate whichever of you walked out with the better find.

title: Axes First, Pizza Second
description: Throw axes at Heber Hatchets, then grab pizza at Mozz so the winner has somewhere comfortable to gloat.

title: Rainy Day Rotation
description: Spend a rainy day bouncing between the BYU Museums Complex and a coffee shop downtown until the weather gives up.

title: Temple Grounds, Then Dessert
description: Walk the temple grounds in Provo as the evening cools off, then head downtown for dessert somewhere that stays open late.

title: Evening Loop Through Downtown
description: Take an evening walk through downtown Provo, ducking into a coffee shop and a thrift store along the way.
